symptom: 完全没有条带 / no bands at all
likely_cause: 二抗宿主与一抗不匹配 / secondary antibody does not match the primary host species
check_or_fix: 确认二抗是 anti-[一抗宿主]（一抗 rabbit 就用 anti-rabbit）；不匹配则更换二抗 / confirm the secondary is anti-[primary host] and replace it if not

symptom: 完全没有条带 / no bands at all
likely_cause: 显影底物（ECL）失效或过期 / ECL substrate inactive or expired
check_or_fix: 检查 ECL 有效期并换新鲜底物；确认 HRP 二抗未失活 / check the ECL date and use fresh substrate; confirm the HRP secondary is active

symptom: 完全没有条带 / no bands at all
likely_cause: 转膜失败（膜未活化、三明治装反、气泡）/ transfer failed (membrane not activated or sandwich reversed or bubbles)
check_or_fix: 转膜后用丽春红染色确认蛋白在膜上；PVDF 须甲醇活化；检查方向和气泡 / Ponceau-stain the membrane after transfer; activate PVDF in methanol; check orientation and bubbles

symptom: 目标条带没有但不确定是抗体还是样本的问题 / no target band and unsure whether antibody or sample is at fault
likely_cause: 缺少阳性对照，无法区分'目标不表达'和'实验失败' / no positive control so target-absent and assay-failed look the same
check_or_fix: 加一条已知表达目标蛋白的裂解液作为阳性对照 / run a lysate known to express the target as a positive control

symptom: 磷酸化蛋白信号很弱或没有 / weak or no signal for a phospho-protein
likely_cause: 用脱脂奶粉封闭，奶粉中的磷蛋白掩盖磷酸化表位 / blocked with milk whose phosphoproteins mask phospho-epitopes
check_or_fix: 封闭和稀释抗体都改用 5% BSA/TBST，不用奶粉 / block and dilute antibodies in 5% BSA in TBST instead of milk

symptom: 整张膜背景高 / high background across the membrane
likely_cause: 封闭不足或抗体浓度过高 / insufficient blocking or antibodies too concentrated
check_or_fix: 室温封闭 1 h（5%）；稀释一抗二抗；增加 TBST 洗涤次数和时间 / block 1 h at room temperature; dilute both antibodies; add TBST washes

symptom: 背景呈斑点状 / speckled or dotted background
likely_cause: 封闭液或抗体液中有颗粒聚集，或膜曾干过 / aggregates in blocking or antibody solution or the membrane dried out
check_or_fix: 过滤封闭液；抗体液离心后使用；全程保持膜湿润 / filter the blocking solution; spin antibody solutions; keep the membrane wet throughout

symptom: 多条非特异条带 / multiple non-specific bands
likely_cause: 一抗浓度过高或特异性差；样本蛋白降解 / primary too concentrated or poorly specific; sample degraded
check_or_fix: 滴定一抗浓度；裂解时加蛋白酶抑制剂；样本保持低温 / titrate the primary; add protease inhibitors at lysis; keep samples cold

symptom: 条带位置与预期分子量不符 / band at an unexpected molecular weight
likely_cause: 翻译后修饰、剪接异构体，或 marker 读错 / post-translational modification or isoform or ladder misread
check_or_fix: 对照预染 marker 重新判读；查文献中该蛋白的表观分子量 / re-read against a pre-stained ladder; check the literature for the apparent size

symptom: 泳道之间条带强弱无法比较 / cannot compare band intensity between lanes
likely_cause: 没有上样对照，上样量差异无法排除 / no loading control so loading differences cannot be ruled out
check_or_fix: 同一张膜检测管家蛋白（GAPDH / β-actin）作上样对照 / probe the same membrane for a housekeeping protein as loading control

symptom: 上样对照条带与目标条带重叠 / loading control band overlaps the target band
likely_cause: 管家蛋白与目标蛋白分子量相近 / housekeeping protein has a similar size to the target
check_or_fix: 换一个分子量不同的上样对照（GAPDH 37 kDa、β-actin 42、tubulin 55）/ pick a loading control at a different size

symptom: 条带笑脸状或变形 / smiling or distorted bands
likely_cause: 电泳过热或样本盐浓度高 / gel overheated or high salt in the sample
check_or_fix: 降低电压、冰上或冷室电泳；样本脱盐或减少上样体积 / run at lower voltage or in the cold; desalt or load less

symptom: 曝光后出现白色（负）条带 / white or negative bands on exposure
likely_cause: 蛋白量或 HRP 过多导致底物局部耗尽 / too much protein or HRP so the substrate is locally depleted
check_or_fix: 减少上样量或稀释抗体；缩短曝光 / load less or dilute antibodies; shorten the exposure

symptom: 无模板对照（NTC）有信号 / signal in the no-template control
likely_cause: 试剂污染或引物二聚体 / reagent contamination or primer dimers
check_or_fix: 每块板都做 NTC；换新水和预混液；看熔解曲线是否为二聚体峰 / run NTC on every plate; use fresh water and master mix; check the melt curve for a dimer peak

symptom: -RT 对照有信号 / signal in the minus-RT control
likely_cause: 基因组 DNA 污染 / genomic DNA contamination
check_or_fix: RNA 做 DNase 处理；引物设计跨外显子连接处 / DNase-treat the RNA; design primers across an exon-exon junction

symptom: 所有样本都没有 Ct 值 / no Ct in any sample
likely_cause: RNA 降解或逆转录失败 / RNA degraded or reverse transcription failed
check_or_fix: 检查 RNA 完整性（A260/280、胶）；换新鲜逆转录酶重做 cDNA / check RNA integrity; remake cDNA with fresh reverse transcriptase

symptom: 某对引物完全不扩增 / one primer pair never amplifies
likely_cause: 引物设计有误或效率低 / primers mis-designed or inefficient
check_or_fix: 用标准曲线验证引物效率（90–110%）；不合格则重新设计 / validate efficiency with a standard curve and redesign if outside 90–110%

symptom: 所有样本 Ct 都很晚（>35）/ late Ct (>35) in every sample
likely_cause: 模板太少或提取残留抑制物（酚、乙醇）/ too little template or carried-over inhibitors
check_or_fix: 重新纯化 RNA；稀释模板看 Ct 是否反而提前 / re-purify the RNA; dilute the template and see whether Ct improves

symptom: 熔解曲线多峰 / multiple peaks in the melt curve
likely_cause: 非特异扩增或引物二聚体（SYBR）/ non-specific amplification or primer dimers with SYBR
check_or_fix: 重新设计引物或提高退火温度；必要时改用 TaqMan 探针 / redesign primers or raise annealing temperature; consider a TaqMan probe

symptom: 内参基因 Ct 随处理变化（如 GAPDH 在处理组和对照组之间不同）/ reference gene Ct shifts with treatment (GAPDH Ct changes between treated and untreated)
likely_cause: 该管家基因在此条件下不稳定 / the housekeeping gene is not stable under this condition
check_or_fix: 测试 2–3 个内参基因，选在你的条件下最稳定的 / test two or three reference genes and keep the stable one

symptom: 复孔之间差异大 / high variability between technical replicates
likely_cause: 移液误差、体积太小、气泡 / pipetting error or tiny volumes or bubbles
check_or_fix: 配预混液再分装；反应体积不低于 10 µL；上机前离心 / make a master mix; keep reactions at 10 µL or more; spin the plate

symptom: 表达倍数结果不合理 / fold-change results make no sense
likely_cause: 未用内参归一化，或引物效率不同 / no reference-gene normalisation or unequal primer efficiencies
check_or_fix: 用 ΔΔCt 并用验证过效率的引物；确认内参稳定 / use ΔΔCt with efficiency-validated primers; confirm the reference gene is stable

symptom: 基因组 DNA 样本也能扩增 / genomic DNA template also amplifies
likely_cause: 引物不跨外显子连接处 / primers do not span an exon junction
check_or_fix: 重新设计跨外显子-外显子连接的引物 / redesign primers across an exon-exon junction

symptom: RNA 产量低 / low RNA yield
likely_cause: 样本量少、裂解不完全或 RNase 污染 / small sample or incomplete lysis or RNase contamination
check_or_fix: 全程无 RNase 操作；选择适合该样本类型的提取试剂盒 / RNase-free workflow throughout; choose an extraction kit suited to the sample type

symptom: 扩增曲线形状异常或提前平台 / abnormal or early-plateau amplification curves
likely_cause: 仪器染料通道与检测化学不匹配，或封板膜问题 / dye channel does not match the chemistry or plate seal issue
check_or_fix: 确认仪器通道与 SYBR/探针一致；用光学封板膜 / confirm the instrument channel matches SYBR or the probe; use optical seals

symptom: 整板包括标准品都没有信号 / no signal in any well including standards
likely_cause: 底物或 HRP 失活、读数波长错误、未加终止液 / substrate or HRP inactive or wrong wavelength or no stop solution
check_or_fix: 换新鲜 TMB；加终止液后在 450 nm 读数 / use fresh TMB; read at 450 nm after adding stop solution

symptom: 标准品正常但样本无信号 / standards work but samples give no signal
likely_cause: 样本浓度低于检测范围或基质效应 / analyte below range or matrix effect
check_or_fix: 减少稀释倍数；标准品用与样本相同的基质稀释 / dilute less; prepare standards in the same matrix as the samples

symptom: 整板背景高 / high background across the plate
likely_cause: 洗涤或封闭不足 / insufficient washing or blocking
check_or_fix: 增加洗涤次数、每次浸泡 30 s；检查洗涤液配方 / add wash cycles with a 30 s soak; check the wash buffer

symptom: 空白孔读数高 / blank wells read high
likely_cause: 检测抗体浓度过高或 TMB 见光 / detection antibody too concentrated or TMB exposed to light
check_or_fix: 滴定检测抗体；TMB 避光保存和使用 / titrate the detection antibody; keep TMB in the dark

symptom: 标准曲线不线性或 R² 低 / standard curve non-linear or low R²
likely_cause: 标准品复溶错误、梯度稀释误差或 hook 效应 / standard reconstituted wrongly or dilution error or hook effect
check_or_fix: 用新标准品重新复溶；至少 5 个点加空白；仔细做梯度稀释 / reconstitute a fresh standard; at least five points plus blank; careful serial dilution

symptom: 样本读数超出最高标准品 / sample readings above the top standard
likely_cause: 样本浓度过高 / sample too concentrated
check_or_fix: 用相同稀释液稀释样本后重测 / dilute the sample in the same diluent and re-run

symptom: 复孔 CV 高 / high CV between duplicates
likely_cause: 移液误差、边缘效应、洗涤不彻底 / pipetting or edge effects or incomplete washing
check_or_fix: 避开边缘孔；统一加样时间；确认每孔洗净 / avoid edge wells; keep timing consistent; confirm complete washing

symptom: 阴性对照有信号 / signal in the negative control
likely_cause: 非特异结合或交叉反应 / non-specific binding or cross-reactivity
check_or_fix: 确认抗体是验证过的配对；增加封闭剂；用与样本相同基质的阴性对照 / confirm a validated pair; add blocker; use a negative control in the sample matrix

symptom: 夹心法有待测物却没有信号 / sandwich ELISA gives no signal although analyte is present
likely_cause: 捕获与检测抗体不是验证配对或识别同一表位 / capture and detection antibodies not a validated pair or bind the same epitope
check_or_fix: 改用验证过的 matched pair（识别不同表位）/ switch to a validated matched pair that binds different epitopes

symptom: 不同板或不同天结果不一致 / results differ between plates or days (different every time on a new plate)
likely_cause: 没有阳性对照，试剂盒批次变化无法察觉 / no positive control so lot changes go unnoticed
check_or_fix: 每块板加一个浓度落在曲线中段的阳性对照 / include a positive control near mid-curve on every plate

symptom: 显色过快、全板饱和 / colour develops too fast and saturates
likely_cause: HRP 偶联物过多或显色时间过长 / too much HRP conjugate or too long a development
check_or_fix: 稀释偶联物；缩短 TMB 时间；及时加终止液 / dilute the conjugate; shorten TMB time; stop promptly

symptom: 板内出现颜色梯度 / colour gradient across the plate
likely_cause: 温度梯度、未封板、边缘蒸发 / temperature gradient or unsealed plate or edge evaporation
check_or_fix: 封板；试剂平衡至室温再用；避免边缘孔 / seal the plate; equilibrate reagents to room temperature; avoid edge wells

symptom: OD 无法扣除本底 / cannot subtract background from OD
likely_cause: 没有做空白 / 零标准 / no blank or zero standard
check_or_fix: 每块板用相同稀释液做空白孔 / include a blank in the same diluent on every plate

symptom: 转染效率低 / low transfection efficiency
likely_cause: 转染试剂与 DNA 比例不当或细胞密度不合适 / wrong reagent-to-DNA ratio or cells at the wrong density
check_or_fix: 优化试剂:DNA 比例；在 70–80% 汇合度时转染 / optimise the reagent-to-DNA ratio; transfect at 70–80% confluence

symptom: 转染效率低 / low transfection efficiency
likely_cause: 质粒质量差（内毒素、A260/280 偏低）/ poor plasmid quality (endotoxin or low A260/280)
check_or_fix: 用无内毒素质粒提取试剂盒重新制备 / re-prepare with an endotoxin-free plasmid kit

symptom: 转染后细胞大量死亡 / cells die after transfection
likely_cause: 试剂毒性、DNA 过量或无血清时间过长 / reagent toxicity or too much DNA or too long in serum-free medium
check_or_fix: 减少试剂和 DNA 用量；4–6 h 后换含血清完全培养基 / reduce reagent and DNA; change to complete medium after 4–6 h

symptom: 转染后不表达 / no expression after transfection
likely_cause: 启动子在该细胞系不活跃或质粒有误 / promoter inactive in this line or wrong plasmid
check_or_fix: 用 GFP 质粒作阳性对照；测序确认质粒；核对启动子 / run a GFP plasmid as a control; sequence the plasmid; check the promoter

symptom: 细胞生长缓慢 / cells grow slowly
likely_cause: 培养基或血清批次不对、代次过高、支原体 / wrong medium or serum lot or high passage or mycoplasma
check_or_fix: 核对培养基配方和血清批次；复苏低代次冻存；做支原体检测 / check medium and serum lot; thaw a low-passage stock; test for mycoplasma

symptom: 贴壁细胞脱落 / adherent cells detach
likely_cause: 胰酶消化过度、污染或板未经 TC 处理 / over-trypsinisation or contamination or plate not TC-treated
check_or_fix: 缩短胰酶时间；用 TC 处理培养板；检查污染 / shorten trypsin exposure; use TC-treated plates; check for contamination

symptom: 培养基浑浊、变色 / medium cloudy or discoloured
likely_cause: 细菌或真菌污染 / bacterial or fungal contamination
check_or_fix: 丢弃并消毒；短期加青链霉素；检查无菌操作 / discard and decontaminate; add pen-strep short-term; review aseptic technique

symptom: 培养基清亮但细胞状态差、长得慢 / medium clear but cells unhealthy and slow
likely_cause: 支原体污染 / mycoplasma contamination
check_or_fix: 做支原体检测；阳性则处理或丢弃并换新冻存 / test for mycoplasma; treat or discard and thaw a fresh stock

symptom: 细胞形态改变 / cells change morphology
likely_cause: 代次过高、血清换批或支原体 / high passage or serum lot change or mycoplasma
check_or_fix: 复苏低代次冻存；固定血清批次 / thaw a low-passage stock; keep the serum lot constant

symptom: 培养基很快变黄 / medium turns yellow quickly
likely_cause: 细胞过密、污染或代谢负荷高 / over-confluent or contaminated or high metabolic load
check_or_fix: 更频繁传代或换液；排查污染 / passage or feed more often; rule out contamination

symptom: 培养基变紫红 / medium turns pink or purple
likely_cause: CO2 不足或培养箱故障 / low CO2 or incubator fault
check_or_fix: 检查培养箱 CO2 和培养基缓冲体系 / check incubator CO2 and the medium buffer system

symptom: 同一方法在某些细胞系有效、另一些无效 / works in one cell line but not another
likely_cause: 难转染细胞系（原代、悬浮）/ hard-to-transfect line (primary or suspension)
check_or_fix: 改用针对该细胞类型的脂质体试剂、电转或病毒载体 / switch to a line-specific lipid reagent or electroporation or viral delivery

symptom: 板内转染不均匀 / uneven transfection across the plate
likely_cause: 复合物未混匀或细胞成团 / complexes not mixed or cells clumped
check_or_fix: 复合物逐滴加入并轻摇；铺板时确保单细胞悬液 / add complexes dropwise and rock; seed as a single-cell suspension
